title: Strategyproof Deep Reinforcement Learning for Online Resource Allocation
abstract: arXiv:2610.37504v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Online resource allocation faces two coupled challenges: (1) allocating scarce resources efficiently under uncertain future demand, and (2) ensuring that agents report task valuations and requirements truthfully (strategyproofness). Reinforcement Learning (RL) adapts allocation decisions through experience but does not necessarily ensure strategyproofness. Existing strategyproof RL uses a linear allocation rule, which limits the resource interactions it can represent. Neural mechanism design methods offer greater expressiveness, but provide only approximate incentive guarantees. Against this background, we introduce the first strategyproof deep RL mechanism for online resource allocation. It integrates three novel components: (i) a monotonic neural network that learns nonlinear interactions by construction (higher reported value cannot reduce acceptance, while a longer reported duration or larger resource requirement cannot increase it

translated_title: 面向在线资源分配的防策略性深度强化学习
translated_abstract: 在线资源分配面临两个相互耦合的挑战：（1）在未来需求不确定的情况下高效分配稀缺资源；（2）确保参与者如实报告任务估值与需求（即防策略性）。强化学习（RL）能够通过经验自适应地调整分配决策，但不一定能保证防策略性。现有的防策略性强化学习方法采用线性分配规则，这限制了其所能表征的资源交互关系。神经机制设计方法具有更强的表达能力，但只能提供近似意义上的激励保证。在此背景下，我们提出了首个用于在线资源分配的防策略性深度强化学习机制。它集成了三个新颖的组件：（i）一个单调神经网络，通过构造方式学习非线性交互（更高的申报估值不会降低接受概率，而更长的申报时长或更大的资源需求不会提高其接受概率
tldr: 本文提出了首个用于在线资源分配的防策略性深度强化学习机制，通过单调神经网络等三个新颖组件，在实现非线性分配规则的同时严格保证参与者的真实申报激励。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the first strategyproof deep RL mechanism for online resource allocation, which integrates a monotonic neural network and other novel components to achieve nonlinear allocation rules while strictly guaranteeing truthful reporting incentives.
